- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.
- Run the linters and fix anything they report.

This charm already integrates with several other charms; follow its existing structure and conventions. Work in this directory. Do not ask questions; make reasonable decisions and finish the task.

+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: the charm sends its workload's (alertmanager's) traces to a tracing backend."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import workload_file
+from ops.testing import Relation, State
+
+CONFIG_PATH = "/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml"
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: str) -> Relation:
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps(
+                [{"protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"}, "url": url}]
+            )
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def tracing_section(context, state: State) -> Optional[dict]:
+    """The `tracing` section of the rendered alertmanager.yml, if any."""
+    config = yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, CONFIG_PATH))
+    return config.get("tracing")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def base_state_with_tracing(container, peer_relation) -> State:
+    return State(
+        leader=True,
+        config={"config_file": ""},
+        containers=[container],
+        relations=[peer_relation, tracing_relation("http://tempo:3200/v1/traces")],
+    )
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_without_the_relation(context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN no `tracing` relation
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no `tracing` section
+    assert tracing_section(context, state) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "url",
+    ["http://tempo:3200/v1/traces", "http://tempo-endpoints.namespace:4318/v1/traces"],
+)
+def test_tracing_section_from_otlp_http_endpoint(
+    context, base_state: State, container, peer_relation, url
+):
+    # GIVEN an `otlp_http` receiver URL over the `tracing` relation
+    relation = tracing_relation(url)
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config sends traces to the endpoint
+    parsed = urlparse(url)
+    tracing = tracing_section(context, state)
+    assert tracing == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": parsed.netloc,
+        "insecure": True,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_https_tracing_uses_ca_cert(context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN an `https` `otlp_http` receiver URL over the `tracing` relation
+    relation = tracing_relation("https://tempo:3200/v1/traces")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config verifies the backend against the charm's CA certificate
+    tracing = tracing_section(context, state)
+    assert tracing["client_type"] == "http"
+    assert tracing["endpoint"] == "tempo:3200"
+    assert tracing["insecure"] is False
+    assert tracing["tls_config"]["ca_file"] == "/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/cos-ca.crt"
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_removed_when_relation_goes_away(
+    context, base_state: State
+):
+    # GIVEN a `tracing` relation is in place
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:3200/v1/traces")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation]
+    )
+    state_in = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+    assert tracing_section(context, state_in) is not None
+
+    # WHEN the relation goes away
+    state_with_relation = dataclasses.replace(

+    )

+    # THEN alertmanager is started with the juju topology in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES

Write a Kubernetes charm, `gotify-k8s`, for Gotify server (https://gotify.net, source https://github.com/gotify/server), a self-hosted push-notification server, using the `ops` library. This directory is empty apart from the context file; create the charm here. Requirements:

  - `GOTIFY_SERVER_PORT` from a `port` config option (integer, default 8080);
  - `GOTIFY_REGISTRATION` (`true` or `false`) from a `registration` config option (boolean, default false), which allows users to sign themselves up;

+# gotify-k8s
+
+A [Juju](https://juju.is) charm that deploys and operates
+[Gotify](https://gotify.net), a self-hosted push notification server, on
+Kubernetes.
+
+The charm runs the upstream OCI image (`ghcr.io/gotify/server`) as a
+[Pebble](https://github.com/canonical/pebble) service in a workload
+container. Gotify's SQLite database lives on the charm's `data`
+filesystem storage, so notifications, users and applications survive
+redeploys.
+
+## Deploy
+
+```shell
+# Build and upload the OCI image for the workload side of the charm.
+docker pull ghcr.io/gotify/server:2.6.3
+docker save -o gotify-image.tar ghcr.io/gotify/server:2.6.3
+
+# Deploy with a fresh copy of the charm source.
+juju deploy ./gotify-k8s.charm --resource gotify-image=gotify-image.tar --trust
+```
+
+## Configure
+
+The initial password of the default admin user (`admin`) is provided
+through a Juju secret:
+
+```shell
+juju add-secret gotify-admin password=<choose-a-password> --info "Gotify admin password"
+juju config gotify-k8s admin-password=<secret-id-from-add-secret>
+```
+
+Other options:
+
+| Option           | Type    | Default | Purpose                                    |
+|------------------|---------|---------|--------------------------------------------|
+| `port`           | int     | 8080    | Port the Gotify server listens on.         |
+| `registration`   | bool    | false   | Whether users may register their accounts. |
+| `admin-password` | secret  | unset   | Secret ID with the admin `password`.       |
+
+The charm blocks until `admin-password` is set to a readable secret.
+Changing any of these options updates the running service.
+
+## Testing
+
+```shell
+uv sync
+uv run pytest tests/unit
+uv run ruff check
+uv run ruff format --check
+uvx charmlint .
+```

+name: gotify-k8s
+type: kubernetes
+title: Gotify
+summary: Self-hosted push notification server
+description: |
+  Gotify is a simple, self-hosted push notification server. It lets you
+  send real-time notifications, alarms and other messages from your own
+  services, scripts and applications to any phone, tablet or desktop,
+  through a web interface and a REST API.
+
+  This charm deploys and operates the Gotify server in a Kubernetes
+  workload container, keeping its SQLite database on persistent
+  filesystem storage. The initial admin user's password is provided as
+  a Juju secret.
+charm-user: non-root

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Kubernetes charm for the Gotify push-notification server.
+
+This charm deploys Gotify (https://gotify.net) as a Pebble service inside
+a Kubernetes workload container, backed by persistent filesystem storage
+for its SQLite database.
+"""
+
+import json
+import logging
+import urllib.request
+
+import ops
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+CONTAINER_NAME = "gotify"
+SERVICE_NAME = "gotify"
+PEBBLE_LAYER_NAME = "gotify"
+
+GOTIFY_COMMAND = "/app/gotify-app"
+GOTIFY_WORKING_DIR = "/app"
+GOTIFY_DATABASE_PATH = "/app/data/gotify.db"
+GOTIFY_DEFAULT_USER = "admin"
+
+DEFAULT_PORT = 8080
+VERSION_TIMEOUT = 5.0
+
+ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION = "admin-password"
+
+
+class AdminPasswordError(Exception):
+    """Raised when the admin-password configuration is missing or unreadable."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
+        """Initialize the error with a user-facing message."""
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message = message
+
+
+def _as_bool(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Coerce a charm config value into a boolean."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    return str(value).strip().lower() in {"true", "1", "yes", "on"}
+
+
+class GotifyCharm(ops.CharmBase):
+    """Charm the Gotify push-notification service on Kubernetes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, framework: ops.Framework) -> None:
+        """Set up event observers for the Gotify charm."""
+        super().__init__(framework)
+        self._container = self.unit.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME)
+
+        event_sources = (
+            self.on.install,
+            self.on.start,
+            self.on.config_changed,
+            self.on.update_status,
+            self.on.data_storage_attached,
+            self.on.secret_changed,
+            self.on[CONTAINER_NAME].pebble_ready,
+        )
+        for event_source in event_sources:
+            self.framework.observe(event_source, self._reconcile)
+
+    def _reconcile(self, _event: ops.EventBase) -> None:
+        """Reconcile the Pebble service with the current charm configuration."""
+        try:
+            admin_password = self._admin_password()
+        except AdminPasswordError as exc:
+            self.unit.status = ops.BlockedStatus(exc.message)
+            logger.error("%s", exc.message)
+            return
+
+        if not self._container.can_connect():
+            self.unit.status = ops.WaitingStatus("waiting for the gotify container")
+            return
+
+        environment = self._service_environment(admin_password)
+        if self._service_needs_update(environment):
+            logger.debug("Updating the gotify service with a new Pebble layer")
+            self._container.add_layer(
+                PEBBLE_LAYER_NAME, self._pebble_layer(environment), combine=True
+            )
+            self._container.replan()
+
+        if self._container.get_service(SERVICE_NAME).is_running():
+            self.unit.status = ops.ActiveStatus()
+            self._set_workload_version()
+        else:
+            self.unit.status = ops.WaitingStatus("waiting for the gotify service to start")
+
+    def _admin_password(self) -> str:
+        """Read the default admin password from the configured Juju secret.
+
+        Returns:
+            The value of the secret's ``password`` key.
+
+        Raises:
+            AdminPasswordError: if the admin-password config option is unset,
+                points to a secret the charm cannot read, or the secret does
+                not contain a ``password`` key.
+        """
+        secret_id = str(self.config.get(ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION, "") or "").removeprefix("secret:")
+        if not secret_id:
+            raise AdminPasswordError(
+                "admin-password must be set to the ID of a Juju secret holding "
+                "the default admin user's password"
+            )
+        try:
+            secret = self.model.get_secret(id=secret_id)
+            content = secret.get_content()
+        except ops.ModelError as exc:
+            raise AdminPasswordError(
+                f"admin-password: unable to read Juju secret {secret_id!r}: {exc}"
+            ) from exc
+        password = content.get("password")
+        if not password:
+            raise AdminPasswordError(
+                "admin-password: the Juju secret must contain a 'password' key"
+            )
+        return password
+
+    def _set_workload_version(self) -> None:
+        """Record the running Gotify version in ``juju status``, best-effort."""
+        version = self._workload_version()
+        if version:
+            self.unit.set_workload_version(version)
+
+    def _workload_version(self) -> str | None:
+        """Read the version from the running Gotify server, if it is up.
+
+        Containers of a Kubernetes pod share a network namespace, so the
+        Gotify REST API is reachable on the configured port from the charm
+        process. The probe is best-effort: when the server is not ready
+        yet, the next event (``update-status`` runs every few minutes)
+        picks the version up.
+        """
+        port = int(self.config.get("port", DEFAULT_PORT) or DEFAULT_PORT)
+        url = f"http://localhost:{port}/version"
+        try:
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=VERSION_TIMEOUT) as response:
+                data = json.loads(response.read())
+        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+            logger.debug("Cannot read the Gotify version from %s yet", url)
+            return None
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            return None
+        version = data.get("version")
+        if isinstance(version, str) and version:
+            return version
+        return None
+
+    def _service_environment(self, admin_password: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Build the environment variables for the gotify Pebble service."""
+        port = int(self.config.get("port", DEFAULT_PORT) or DEFAULT_PORT)
+        registration = _as_bool(self.config.get("registration", False))
+        return {
+            "GOTIFY_SERVER_PORT": str(port),
+            "GOTIFY_REGISTRATION": "true" if registration else "false",
+            "GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME": GOTIFY_DEFAULT_USER,
+            "GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS": admin_password,
+            "GOTIFY_DATABASE_DIALECT": "sqlite3",
+            "GOTIFY_DATABASE_CONNECTION": GOTIFY_DATABASE_PATH,
+        }
+
+    def _pebble_layer(self, environment: dict[str, str]) -> ops.pebble.Layer:
+        """Build the Pebble layer for the gotify service."""
+        return ops.pebble.Layer(
+            {
+                "summary": "gotify layer",
+                "description": "Pebble layer for the gotify push-notification service",
+                "services": {
+                    SERVICE_NAME: {
+                        "override": "replace",
+                        "startup": "enabled",
+                        "command": GOTIFY_COMMAND,
+                        "working-dir": GOTIFY_WORKING_DIR,
+                        "environment": environment,
+                    },
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    def _service_needs_update(self, environment: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+        """Report whether the gotify service must be configured or restarted."""
+        try:
+            running = self._container.get_service(SERVICE_NAME).is_running()
+        except ops.ModelError:
+            # The service does not exist yet.
+            running = False
+        current = self._container.get_plan().services.get(SERVICE_NAME)
+        return (
+            not running
+            or current is None
+            or current.command != GOTIFY_COMMAND
+            or current.working_dir != GOTIFY_WORKING_DIR
+            or current.startup != ops.pebble.ServiceStartup.ENABLED.value
+            or current.environment != environment
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    ops.main(GotifyCharm)

+"""Unit tests for the gotify-k8s charm."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import ops
+import ops.testing
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+from charm import ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION, GotifyCharm
+
+CHARMCRAFT_YAML = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "charmcraft.yaml"
+_METADATA = yaml.safe_load(CHARMCRAFT_YAML.read_text())
+
+CONTAINER_NAME = "gotify"
+SERVICE_NAME = "gotify"
+STORAGE_NAME = "data"
+ADMIN_SECRET_ID = "cdi6fmr1c0qrh7gqrjg0"
+OTHER_SECRET_ID = "cdi6fmr1c0oldsecr000"
+ADMIN_PASSWORD = "sup3rs3cr3t"
+NEW_PASSWORD = "n3wp4ssw0rd"
+PORT = 8080
+CHANGED_PORT = 9090
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(name="ctx")
+def ctx_fixture() -> ops.testing.Context:
+    """Provide a Scenario context with the charm's metadata."""
+    return ops.testing.Context(GotifyCharm, meta=_METADATA)
+
+
+def make_container(tmp_path, *, can_connect: bool = True) -> ops.testing.Container:
+    """Build the gotify workload container state."""
+    return ops.testing.Container(
+        name=CONTAINER_NAME,
+        can_connect=can_connect,
+        mounts={STORAGE_NAME: ops.testing.Mount(location="/app/data", source=tmp_path)},
+    )
+
+
+def make_admin_secret(
+    *,
+    secret_id: str = ADMIN_SECRET_ID,
+    contents: dict | None = None,
+) -> ops.testing.Secret:
+    """Build the Juju secret holding the default admin user's password."""
+    if contents is None:
+        contents = {"password": ADMIN_PASSWORD}
+    return ops.testing.Secret(contents, id=secret_id)
+
+
+def service_environment(state: ops.testing.State) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return the environment of the gotify Pebble service in a state."""
+    container = state.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME)
+    return container.plan.services[SERVICE_NAME].environment
+
+
+class _FakeVersionResponse:
+    """A minimal ``urlopen`` context manager returning a fixed payload."""
+
+    def __init__(self, payload: bytes):
+        self._payload = payload
+
+    def read(self) -> bytes:
+        """Return the HTTP response body."""
+        return self._payload
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *_exc) -> None:
+        return None
+
+
+def _refused_urlopen(*_args, **_kwargs):
+    """Stand in for ``urlopen`` when nothing is listening."""
+    raise ConnectionRefusedError("no server in unit tests")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def offline(monkeypatch):
+    """Keep the charm's version probe off the test machine's network."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr("urllib.request.urlopen", _refused_urlopen)
+
+
+def test_blocked_when_admin_password_unset(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """Without admin-password the charm blocks and names the option."""
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(containers=[container])
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert isinstance(out.unit_status, ops.BlockedStatus)
+    assert "admin-password" in out.unit_status.message
+
+
+def test_blocked_when_secret_cannot_be_read(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """An admin-password secret the charm cannot read blocks the charm."""
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{OTHER_SECRET_ID}"},
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert isinstance(out.unit_status, ops.BlockedStatus)
+    assert "admin-password" in out.unit_status.message
+
+
+def test_blocked_when_password_key_missing(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """A secret without a password key blocks the charm."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret(contents={"token": "not-a-password"})
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert isinstance(out.unit_status, ops.BlockedStatus)
+    assert "admin-password" in out.unit_status.message
+
+
+def test_waiting_when_container_not_reachable(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """The charm waits while the workload container is not reachable."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path, can_connect=False)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.install(), state)
+    assert isinstance(out.unit_status, ops.WaitingStatus)
+
+
+def test_blocked_takes_precedence_over_waiting(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """A missing admin-password blocks even while the container is unreachable."""
+    container = make_container(tmp_path, can_connect=False)
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.install(), ops.testing.State(containers=[container]))
+    assert isinstance(out.unit_status, ops.BlockedStatus)
+    assert "admin-password" in out.unit_status.message
+
+
+def test_active_when_service_running(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """With a valid secret the service is configured, running and active."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+
+    out_container = out.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME)
+    assert out_container.services[SERVICE_NAME].is_running()
+
+    assert service_environment(out) == {
+        "GOTIFY_SERVER_PORT": str(PORT),
+        "GOTIFY_REGISTRATION": "false",
+        "GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME": "admin",
+        "GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS": ADMIN_PASSWORD,
+        "GOTIFY_DATABASE_DIALECT": "sqlite3",
+        "GOTIFY_DATABASE_CONNECTION": "/app/data/gotify.db",
+    }
+
+    service = out_container.plan.services[SERVICE_NAME]
+    assert service.command == "/app/gotify-app"
+    assert service.working_dir == "/app"
+    assert service.startup == ops.pebble.ServiceStartup.ENABLED.value
+
+
+def test_config_change_updates_running_service(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """Changing configuration updates the running gotify service."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+
+    # Change the port, registration and the admin password secret.
+    new_secret = make_admin_secret(secret_id=OTHER_SECRET_ID, contents={"password": NEW_PASSWORD})
+    changed_state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[out.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME)],
+        config={
+            ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{OTHER_SECRET_ID}",
+            "port": CHANGED_PORT,
+            "registration": True,
+        },
+        secrets=[new_secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.config_changed(), changed_state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+    assert out.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME).services[SERVICE_NAME].is_running()
+
+    environment = service_environment(out)
+    assert environment["GOTIFY_SERVER_PORT"] == str(CHANGED_PORT)
+    assert environment["GOTIFY_REGISTRATION"] == "true"
+    assert environment["GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS"] == NEW_PASSWORD
+
+
+def test_registration_true(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """Enabling registration is reflected in the service environment."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={
+            ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}",
+            "registration": True,
+        },
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+    assert service_environment(out)["GOTIFY_REGISTRATION"] == "true"
+
+
+def test_workload_version_reported_when_server_answers(ctx, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """The running Gotify version is read from its /version endpoint."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+
+    def fake_urlopen(url, timeout=None):
+        assert url == f"http://localhost:{PORT}/version"
+        return _FakeVersionResponse(b'{"version": "2.6.3", "commit": "abc123"}')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("urllib.request.urlopen", fake_urlopen)
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+    assert out.workload_version == "2.6.3"
+
+
+def test_workload_version_left_unset_when_server_down(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """An unreachable /version endpoint does not break the reconcile."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.pebble_ready(container), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+    assert out.workload_version == ""
+
+
+def test_storage_attached_reconciles_service(ctx, tmp_path):
+    """Attaching the data storage (re)configures the gotify service."""
+    secret = make_admin_secret()
+    container = make_container(tmp_path)
+    storage = ops.testing.Storage(name=STORAGE_NAME)
+    state = ops.testing.State(
+        containers=[container],
+        storages=[storage],
+        config={ADMIN_PASSWORD_OPTION: f"secret:{ADMIN_SECRET_ID}"},
+        secrets=[secret],
+    )
+    out = ctx.run(ctx.on.storage_attached(storage), state)
+    assert out.unit_status == ops.ActiveStatus()
+    assert out.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME).services[SERVICE_NAME].is_running()

+# pushgateway-k8s
+
+[![Charm](https://charmhub.io/pushgateway-k8s/badge.svg)](https://charmhub.io/pushgateway-k8s)
+[![Juju](https://img.shields.io/badge/juju-3.6+-green)](https://juju.is)
+
+## Overview
+
+A [Juju](https://juju.is) charm for the
+[Prometheus Pushgateway](https://github.com/prometheus/pushgateway) on
+Kubernetes.
+
+The Pushgateway allows ephemeral and batch jobs, which cannot be scraped by
+Prometheus before they terminate, to push their metrics so that Prometheus can
+scrape them afterwards. This charm deploys and operates Pushgateway on
+Kubernetes:
+
+- the workload runs as a Pebble service in the `pushgateway` container,
+- pushed metrics are persisted to filesystem storage (`/data/metrics`), so
+  they survive restarts,
+- the unit opens the default Pushgateway port (9091/tcp),
+- a `metrics-endpoint` (`prometheus_scrape`) integration lets a Prometheus
+  charm (such as [prometheus-k8s](https://charmhub.io/prometheus-k8s))
+  discover and scrape this unit's metrics endpoint.
+
+## Usage
+
+```console
+juju deploy pushgateway-k8s --resource pushgateway-image=ubuntu/prometheus-pushgateway:1.11-24.04_stable
+juju integrate pushgateway-k8s prometheus-k8s:metrics-endpoint
+```
+
+## Development
+
+Set up the project with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):
+
+```console
+uv sync
+```
+
+Run the unit tests:
+
+```console
+uv run pytest tests/unit
+```
+
+Lint and format the code:
+
+```console
+uv run ruff check
+uv run ruff format --check
+```
+
+## License
+
+The charm is distributed under the terms of the
+[Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+
+# Copyright 2025 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""A Juju charmed operator for the Prometheus Pushgateway.
+
+The Pushgateway allows ephemeral and batch jobs, which cannot be scraped by
+Prometheus before they terminate, to push their metrics so that Prometheus can
+scrape them afterwards.
+
+This charm deploys Pushgateway on Kubernetes as a Pebble-managed workload,
+persists pushed metrics across restarts in filesystem storage, and exposes a
+prometheus_scrape metrics endpoint for Prometheus.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import re
+import socket
+from typing import Any
+
+import ops
+from charms.prometheus_k8s.v0.prometheus_scrape import MetricsEndpointProvider
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Pebble container and service names, matching the metadata.
+CONTAINER_NAME = "pushgateway"
+SERVICE_NAME = "pushgateway"
+
+# Port the Pushgateway listens on by default (--web.listen-address=:9091).
+PUSHGATEWAY_PORT = 9091
+
+# Path at which Pushgateway exposes its metrics.
+METRICS_PATH = "/metrics"
+
+# Pushgateway binary, as shipped in the ubuntu/prometheus-pushgateway image.
+PUSHGATEWAY_BINARY = "/bin/pushgateway"
+
+# By default Pushgateway keeps pushed metrics in memory only, so they are lost
+# on restart; persisting them to a file in the mounted storage means they
+# survive restarts.
+PERSISTENCE_FILE = "/data/metrics"
+
+# Relation endpoint over which Prometheus discovers and scrapes this unit.
+METRICS_RELATION_NAME = "metrics-endpoint"
+
+# The version banner printed by `pushgateway --version`, e.g.
+# "pushgateway, version 1.11.0 (branch: HEAD, revision: ...)".
+_VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(r"pushgateway, version (\S+)")
+
+
+class PushgatewayCharm(ops.CharmBase):
+    """Charm that runs Prometheus Pushgateway on Kubernetes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args)
+        self.container = self.unit.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME)
+
+        # Publish a scrape job pointing at this unit so that a related
+        # Prometheus charm knows how to scrape this Pushgateway.
+        self._scrape_provider = MetricsEndpointProvider(
+            self,
+            relation_name=METRICS_RELATION_NAME,
+            jobs=self._scrape_jobs(),
+            refresh_event=[self.on.update_status],
+        )
+
+        self.framework.observe(self.on.pushgateway_pebble_ready, self._configure)
+        self.framework.observe(self.on.install, self._configure)
+        self.framework.observe(self.on.start, self._configure)
+        self.framework.observe(self.on.update_status, self._configure)
+
+    @property
+    def _hostname(self) -> str:
+        """This unit's address: the Kubernetes pod's hostname."""
+        return socket.getfqdn()
+
+    def _scrape_jobs(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Return the Prometheus scrape job targeting this unit."""
+        return [
+            {
+                "job_name": SERVICE_NAME,
+                "metrics_path": METRICS_PATH,
+                "static_configs": [{"targets": [f"{self._hostname}:{PUSHGATEWAY_PORT}"]}],
+            }
+        ]
+
+    def _pebble_layer(self) -> ops.pebble.Layer:
+        """Return the Pebble layer that runs the Pushgateway workload.
+
+        The service starts automatically (``startup: enabled``) and Pushgateway
+        listens on its default port, 9091.
+        """
+        return ops.pebble.Layer(
+            {
+                "summary": "pushgateway layer",
+                "description": "Pebble config layer for Prometheus Pushgateway",
+                "services": {
+                    SERVICE_NAME: {
+                        "override": "replace",
+                        "summary": "Prometheus Pushgateway",
+                        "command": f"{PUSHGATEWAY_BINARY} --persistence.file={PERSISTENCE_FILE}",
+                        "startup": "enabled",
+                    },
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    def _configure(self, event: ops.EventBase) -> None:
+        """Ensure the workload is running and report status accordingly.
+
+        Args:
+            event: The event that triggered this handler.
+        """
+        if not self.container.can_connect():
+            self.unit.status = ops.WaitingStatus("waiting for Pebble to be ready")
+            return
+
+        self._update_layer()
+
+        service = self.container.get_service(SERVICE_NAME)
+        if not service.is_running():
+            self.container.start(SERVICE_NAME)
+            logger.info("started the %s Pebble service", SERVICE_NAME)
+
+        self._set_workload_version()
+        self._open_port()
+
+        self.unit.status = ops.ActiveStatus()
+
+    def _update_layer(self) -> None:
+        """Add the Pushgateway Pebble layer if it is not in the plan yet."""
+        plan = self.container.get_plan()
+        layer = self._pebble_layer()
+        if plan.services != layer.services:
+            self.container.add_layer(SERVICE_NAME, layer, combine=True)
+            logger.info("added the %s Pebble layer", SERVICE_NAME)
+
+    def _set_workload_version(self) -> None:
+        """Report the running Pushgateway's version to Juju."""
+        try:
+            # `pushgateway --version` writes its banner to stderr, not stdout.
+            stdout, stderr = self.container.exec([PUSHGATEWAY_BINARY, "--version"]).wait_output()
+        except ops.pebble.Error as error:
+            logger.warning("could not determine the Pushgateway version: %s", error)
+            return
+        match = _VERSION_PATTERN.search(stdout or stderr)
+        if match is None:
+            logger.warning("could not parse the Pushgateway version banner")
+            return
+        self.unit.set_workload_version(match.group(1))
+
+    def _open_port(self) -> None:
+        """Open the Pushgateway port on the unit, if it is not open yet."""
+        if all(port.port != PUSHGATEWAY_PORT for port in self.unit.opened_ports()):
+            self.unit.open_port(protocol="tcp", port=PUSHGATEWAY_PORT)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: nocover
+    ops.main(PushgatewayCharm)

Add a `get-configuration` action to this charm, so operators can inspect the HAProxy configuration a unit is running, for debugging, without shell access to the unit. Requirements:

- The action takes no parameters. It reads the configuration currently on disk (`/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg`, the file HAProxy is running with), using the file helpers in `src/haproxy.py`, and returns it in the `configuration` result, with a `source` result of `disk`. It must not write to disk or reload the service.
- If the file isn't there, the action fails with a message saying it was not found.
- Client IP hash salts (see the `client-ip-hash-salt` option) must not leak: redact any salt in the returned configuration as `<redacted>`.
- If the configuration on disk is exactly the charm's default configuration (what it renders when no proxy backends are configured; `HAProxyService.render_default_config`), log a message through the action that says it matches the default configuration and that this usually means no proxy backends are configured. If the charm state needed to render the default is invalid, still return the configuration, and log that it could not determine whether this is the default configuration.
- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.
- Run the linters and fix anything they report.

- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.

Use the `tempo_coordinator_k8s` `tracing` charm library (charms.tempo_coordinator_k8s.v0.tracing) on a new `tracing` endpoint (interface `tracing`, at most one relation), and request the `otlp_http` protocol. - For a plain `http` endpoint, set `insecure: true`. For `https`, set `insecure: false` and verify the backend against the CA certificate the charm already uses (`tls_config.ca_file`).
- When the relation goes away, the `tracing` section must go too.
- Label the workload's traces with the Juju topology: start Alertmanager with an `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` environment variable carrying `juju_application`, `juju_model`, `juju_model_uuid`, `juju_unit` and `juju_charm`.
- The existing `charm-tracing` endpoint (the charm's own traces) stays as it is.
- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.
- Run the linters and fix anything they report.

Follow the charm's existing structure and conventions. Work in this directory. Do not ask questions; make reasonable decisions and finish the task.

+# Copyright 2025 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: alertmanager sends workload traces to a related tempo."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import workload_file
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+from config_builder import ConfigBuilder
+
+TEMPO_HOST = "tempo-0.tempo-endpoints.cos.svc.cluster.local:4318"
+
+
+def receivers(scheme: str) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(
+        [
+            {
+                "protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"},
+                "url": f"{scheme}://{TEMPO_HOST}/v1/traces",
+            }
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def tracing_relation(scheme: str) -> Relation:
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing", remote_app_name="tempo", remote_app_data={"receivers": receivers(scheme)}
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path))
+
+
+class TestConfigBuilder:
+    """The tracing section of the config, built in isolation from the charm."""
+
+    def test_no_tracing_section_when_tracing_is_not_configured(self):
+        # GIVEN a config where tracing is never configured
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(ConfigBuilder().build().alertmanager)
+
+        # THEN it has no tracing section
+        assert "tracing" not in config
+
+    def test_no_tracing_section_when_there_is_no_endpoint(self):
+        # GIVEN a config with no tracing endpoint
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(
+            ConfigBuilder().set_workload_tracing(endpoint=None, ca_cert_path="").build().alertmanager
+        )
+
+        # THEN it has no tracing section
+        assert "tracing" not in config
+
+    def test_an_http_endpoint_is_traced_insecurely(self):
+        # GIVEN a plain HTTP tracing endpoint
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(
+            ConfigBuilder()
+            .set_workload_tracing(endpoint=f"http://{TEMPO_HOST}/v1/traces", ca_cert_path="")
+            .build()
+            .alertmanager
+        )
+
+        # THEN traces are sent to host:port over an insecure connection, with no TLS config
+        assert config["tracing"] == {
+            "client_type": "http",
+            "endpoint": TEMPO_HOST,
+            "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+            "insecure": True,
+        }
+
+    def test_an_https_endpoint_is_traced_against_a_ca_certificate(self):
+        # GIVEN an HTTPS tracing endpoint and a CA certificate
+        ca_path = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
+
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(
+            ConfigBuilder()
+            .set_workload_tracing(endpoint=f"https://{TEMPO_HOST}/v1/traces", ca_cert_path=ca_path)
+            .build()
+            .alertmanager
+        )
+
+        # THEN traces are sent securely and verified against that CA
+        assert config["tracing"] == {
+            "client_type": "http",
+            "endpoint": TEMPO_HOST,
+            "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+            "insecure": False,
+            "tls_config": {"ca_file": ca_path},
+        }
+
+
+def test_workload_config_has_no_tracing_section_without_a_tracing_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm with no tracing relation
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the workload config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_an_http_tempo_endpoint_is_written_to_the_workload_config(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tempo serving OTLP over HTTP
+    relation = tracing_relation("http")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the workload traces to tempo over an insecure connection
+    tracing = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)["tracing"]
+    assert tracing["client_type"] == "http"
+    assert tracing["endpoint"] == TEMPO_HOST
+    assert tracing["insecure"] is True
+    assert "tls_config" not in tracing
+
+
+def test_an_https_tempo_endpoint_is_written_to_the_workload_config(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tempo serving OTLP over HTTPS
+    relation = tracing_relation("https")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the workload traces to tempo securely, verifying against a CA certificate
+    tracing = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)["tracing"]
+    assert tracing["endpoint"] == TEMPO_HOST
+    assert tracing["insecure"] is False
+    assert "ca_file" in tracing["tls_config"]
+
+
+def test_tracing_is_removed_from_the_workload_config_when_tempo_goes_away(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm that is tracing to tempo
+    relation = tracing_relation("http")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+    assert "tracing" in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+    # WHEN the tracing relation is broken, which it departs during, not before
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_broken(state.get_relation(relation.id)), state)
+
+    # THEN the workload no longer traces
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "topology_key",
+    ["juju_application", "juju_model", "juju_model_uuid", "juju_unit", "juju_charm"],
+)
+def test_workload_traces_are_labelled_with_juju_topology(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, topology_key: str
+):
+    # GIVEN a ready charm
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the workload is started with juju topology in its OTEL resource attributes
+    environment = state.get_container("alertmanager").plan.services["alertmanager"].environment
+    assert f"{topology_key}=" in environment["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"]

+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: alertmanager sends its own (workload) traces to the tracing backend it is related to.
+
+The workload's traces go to the `tracing` relation's backend; the charm's own traces go over
+`charm-tracing` instead. The two are configured independently.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+from typing import Optional
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import workload_path
+from ops.model import ActiveStatus
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: str, endpoint: str = "tracing") -> Relation:
+    """A relation whose remote side (e.g. Tempo) receives OTLP HTTP traces at `url`."""
+    receivers = [{"protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"}, "url": url}]
+    return Relation(
+        endpoint,
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={"receivers": json.dumps(receivers)},
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_tracing(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> Optional[dict]:
+    """The `tracing` section of the rendered alertmanager config, if it has one."""
+    config = yaml.safe_load(
+        workload_path(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path).read_text()
+    )
+    return config.get("tracing")
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_without_the_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN no tracing backend is related
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the config has no tracing section
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) is None
+
+
+def test_charm_is_active_while_the_backend_has_not_published_its_receivers(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a `tracing` relation whose backend hasn't published its receivers yet
+    relation = Relation("tracing", remote_app_name="tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the relation changes
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the charm is active
+    assert isinstance(state.unit_status, ActiveStatus)
+
+    # AND the config has no tracing section
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) is None
+
+
+def test_charm_tracing_alone_leaves_the_workload_config_alone(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a backend related over `charm-tracing` only, for the charm's own traces
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318", endpoint="charm-tracing")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), state)
+
+    # THEN the workload's config has no tracing section
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) is None
+
+
+def test_charm_requests_the_otlp_http_protocol(context: Context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN alertmanager is related to a tracing backend
+    relation = Relation("tracing", remote_app_name="tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_created(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN it has asked the backend for an otlp_http receiver
+    assert state.get_relation(relation.id).local_app_data == {
+        "receivers": json.dumps(["otlp_http"])
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("leader", [True, False])
+def test_traces_are_sent_to_the_related_backend_over_http(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm, leader: bool
+):
+    # GIVEN alertmanager is related to a backend receiving OTLP over plain http
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, leader=leader, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the backend publishes its receivers
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the config sends every span of the workload to that backend
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:4318",
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "insecure": True,
+    }
+
+    # AND the charm is active
+    assert isinstance(state.unit_status, ActiveStatus)
+
+
+def test_an_https_endpoint_is_verified_against_the_ca_certificate(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN alertmanager is related to a backend receiving OTLP over https
+    relation = tracing_relation("https://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the backend publishes its receivers
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the config verifies the backend against the CA the charm already uses
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:4318",
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "insecure": False,
+        "tls_config": {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path},
+    }
+
+
+def test_the_scheme_and_path_are_dropped_from_the_receiver_url(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    """Alertmanager's `endpoint` field takes a bare `host:port`, and appends the path itself."""
+    # GIVEN a receiver URL that carries a scheme and a path
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318/tempo/traces")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the backend publishes its receivers
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the config points at the bare host and port
+    tracing = rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert tracing is not None
+    assert tracing["endpoint"] == "tempo:4318"
+
+
+def test_the_tracing_section_goes_away_with_the_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN an alertmanager sending traces to a related backend
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) is not None
+
+    # WHEN the relation goes away
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_broken(state.get_relation(relation.id)), state)
+    state = dataclasses.replace(
+        state, relations=[r for r in state.relations if r.id != relation.id]
+    )
+    state = context.run(context.on.update_status(), state)
+
+    # THEN the config has no tracing section
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) is None
+
+
+def test_the_relation_overrides_a_tracing_section_in_the_user_config(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a config file that sends traces elsewhere, and a related tracing backend
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state,
+        config={"config_file": yaml.safe_dump({"tracing": {"endpoint": "elsewhere:1234"}})},
+        relations=[*base_state.relations, relation],
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the backend publishes its receivers
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the config sends the workload's traces to the related backend
+    tracing = rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert tracing is not None
+    assert tracing["endpoint"] == "tempo:4318"
+
+
+def test_a_tracing_section_in_the_user_config_survives_without_the_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a config file that sends traces elsewhere, with no tracing relation
+    user_tracing = {"client_type": "http", "endpoint": "elsewhere:1234"}
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, config={"config_file": yaml.safe_dump({"tracing": user_tracing})}
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the config sends traces where the user asked
+    assert rendered_tracing(context, state, alertmanager_charm) == user_tracing
+
+
+def test_workload_traces_are_labeled_with_the_juju_topology(
+    context: Context, base_state: State
+):
+    """The workload's spans carry the juju topology, so a backend can tell deployments apart."""
+    # GIVEN an alertmanager workload
+    with context(context.on.config_changed(), base_state) as mgr:
+        state = mgr.run()
+        charm = mgr.charm
+
+    # THEN it is started with its traces labeled by the juju topology
+    service = state.get_container("alertmanager").plan.services["alertmanager"]
+    attributes = dict(
+        pair.split("=", 1)
+        for pair in service.environment["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"].split(",")
+    )
+    assert attributes == {
+        "juju_model": charm.model.name,
+        "juju_model_uuid": charm.model.uuid,
+        "juju_application": charm.model.app.name,
+        "juju_unit": charm.model.unit.name,
+        "juju_charm": charm.meta.name,
+    }

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: the workload sends its own traces to a tracing backend related over "tracing"."""
+
+import dataclasses
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from charms.tempo_coordinator_k8s.v0.tracing import (
+    ProtocolType,
+    Receiver,
+    TracingProviderAppData,
+    TransportProtocolType,
+)
+from helpers import CONTAINER_NAME, SERVICE_NAME, workload_path
+from ops.model import ActiveStatus, BlockedStatus
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+TRACING_ENDPOINT = "tempo:4318"
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: str) -> Relation:
+    """A "tracing" relation whose remote app receives traces at the given OTLP/HTTP URL."""
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data=dict(
+            TracingProviderAppData(
+                receivers=[
+                    Receiver(
+                        url=url,
+                        protocol=ProtocolType(name="otlp_http", type=TransportProtocolType.http),
+                    )
+                ]
+            ).dump()
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    """The rendered alertmanager.yml, as read back from the workload container."""
+    return yaml.safe_load(
+        workload_path(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path).read_text()
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "url, insecure",
+    [
+        pytest.param(f"http://{TRACING_ENDPOINT}", True, id="http"),
+        pytest.param(f"https://{TRACING_ENDPOINT}", False, id="https"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_tracing_section_is_rendered_from_the_related_endpoint(
+    context: Context,
+    base_state: State,
+    alertmanager_charm,
+    url: str,
+    insecure: bool,
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = tracing_relation(url)
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the backend publishes its receivers
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the charm is active
+    assert isinstance(state.unit_status, ActiveStatus)
+
+    # AND the rendered config sends every trace to the backend
+    expected = {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        # alertmanager accepts no scheme (or path) in its endpoint field
+        "endpoint": TRACING_ENDPOINT,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "insecure": insecure,
+    }
+    if not insecure:
+        # An https backend is verified against the CA certificate of the "certificates" relation
+        expected["tls_config"] = {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path}
+    assert rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)["tracing"] == expected
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_while_the_backend_has_not_published_an_endpoint(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend that has not published receivers yet
+    relation = Relation("tracing", remote_app_name="tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+

+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: the charm sends alertmanager's own traces to a tracing backend such as Tempo."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+from typing import Optional
+
+import yaml
+from cosl import JujuTopology
+from helpers import SERVICE_NAME, container_of, workload_file
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: Optional[str] = None) -> Relation:
+    """A "tracing" relation to a Tempo-like provider, announcing an otlp_http receiver.
+
+    Args:
+        url: the receiver url the provider publishes; None leaves the databag empty.
+    """
+    receivers = [{"url": url, "protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"}}] if url else []
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={"receivers": json.dumps(receivers)},
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path))
+
+
+def test_charm_requests_the_otlp_http_protocol(context: Context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = tracing_relation()
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the charm requests the otlp_http protocol from the provider
+    relation_out = state_out.get_relations("tracing")[0]
+    assert json.loads(relation_out.local_app_data["receivers"]) == ["otlp_http"]
+
+
+def test_workload_traces_are_sent_to_the_related_backend(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN alertmanager sends its workload traces to the backend
+    config = rendered_config(context, state_out, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:4318",
+        "insecure": True,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_workload_traces_to_an_https_backend_are_verified_against_the_charm_ca(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to an https tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = tracing_relation("https://tempo:443")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the backend is verified against the CA certificate the charm already uses
+    config = rendered_config(context, state_out, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:443",
+        "insecure": False,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "tls_config": {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path},
+    }
+
+
+def test_the_tracing_section_is_removed_when_the_relation_goes_away(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm whose rendered config has a "tracing" section
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+    assert "tracing" in rendered_config(context, state_out, alertmanager_charm)
+
+    # WHEN the tracing relation goes away
+    state_without_tracing = dataclasses.replace(
+        state_out,
+        relations=[r for r in state_out.relations if r.endpoint != "tracing"],
+    )
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.update_status(), state_without_tracing)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config no longer has a "tracing" section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state_out, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_the_workload_is_started_with_juju_topology_resource_attributes(
+    context: Context, base_state: State
+):
+    # GIVEN a ready charm
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    with context(context.on.update_status(), base_state) as mgr:
+        expected = JujuTopology.from_charm(mgr.charm).to_baggage()
+
+    state_out = context.run(context.on.update_status(), base_state)
+    environment = container_of(state_out).plan.services[SERVICE_NAME].environment
+
+    # THEN the workload is started with its traces labelled with the juju topology
+    assert environment["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"] == expected

+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+
+def tracing_relation(*urls: str, protocol: str = "otlp_http") -> Relation:
+    """A `tracing` relation whose remote (the tracing backend) offers these receiver urls."""
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps(
+                [{"protocol": {"name": protocol, "type": "http"}, "url": url} for url in urls]
+            )
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def with_tracing(base_state: State) -> State:
+    """A charm related to a tracing backend over an http OTLP endpoint."""
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo-endpoints.model.svc.cluster.local:4318")
+    return dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+
+def test_charm_requests_the_otlp_http_protocol(context: Context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = Relation("tracing")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_created(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN it requests the otlp_http protocol, so the backend enables that receiver
+    local_app_data = state.get_relation(relation.id).local_app_data
+    assert json.loads(local_app_data["receivers"]) == ["otlp_http"]
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_without_a_tracing_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm without a "tracing" relation
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_targets_the_http_endpoint_the_backend_published(
+    context: Context, with_tracing: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing a plain http OTLP endpoint
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    relation = with_tracing.get_relations("tracing")[0]
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), with_tracing)
+
+    # THEN alertmanager is configured to send all of its traces to it
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        # Alertmanager accepts a bare host:port here: no scheme and no path.
+        "endpoint": "tempo-endpoints.model.svc.cluster.local:4318",
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "insecure": True,
+    }
+
+
+def test_tracing_endpoint_loses_any_scheme_and_path(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing its endpoint behind an ingress, with a path
+    relation = tracing_relation("https://tempo.example.com:443/tempo/otlp-http")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN only the host:port makes it into the config, and the backend is verified
+    # against the charm's CA certificate
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"]["endpoint"] == "tempo.example.com:443"
+    assert config["tracing"]["insecure"] is False
+    assert config["tracing"]["tls_config"] == {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path}
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_is_removed_when_the_relation_goes_away(
+    context: Context, with_tracing: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm configured to send its traces to a backend
+    relation = with_tracing.get_relations("tracing")[0]
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), with_tracing)
+    assert "tracing" in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+    # WHEN the relation is removed
+    relation = state.get_relations("tracing")[0]
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_broken(relation), state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_workload_traces_are_labeled_with_the_juju_topology(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm (related or not: the topology labels are always set)
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+    with context(context.on.update_status(), state) as mgr:
+        expected = {
+            "juju_application": mgr.charm.app.name,
+            "juju_model": mgr.charm.model.name,
+            "juju_model_uuid": mgr.charm.model.uuid,
+            "juju_unit": mgr.charm.unit.name,
+            "juju_charm": mgr.charm.meta.name,
+        }
+
+    # THEN the workload is started with its traces labeled with the juju topology
+    environment = container_of(state).plan.services[SERVICE_NAME].environment
+    attributes = dict(
+        pair.split("=", 1) for pair in environment["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"].split(",")
+    )
+    assert attributes == expected

+# Copyright 2025 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: alertmanager sends workload traces to a related tempo."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import workload_file
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+from config_builder import ConfigBuilder
+
+TEMPO_HOST = "tempo-0.tempo-endpoints.cos.svc.cluster.local:4318"
+
+
+def receivers(scheme: str) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(
+        [
+            {
+                "protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"},
+                "url": f"{scheme}://{TEMPO_HOST}/v1/traces",
+            }
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def tracing_relation(scheme: str) -> Relation:
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing", remote_app_name="tempo", remote_app_data={"receivers": receivers(scheme)}
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path))
+
+
+class TestConfigBuilder:
+    """The tracing section of the config, built in isolation from the charm."""
+
+    def test_no_tracing_section_when_tracing_is_not_configured(self):
+        # GIVEN a config where tracing is never configured
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(ConfigBuilder().build().alertmanager)
+
+        # THEN it has no tracing section
+        assert "tracing" not in config
+
+    def test_no_tracing_section_when_there_is_no_endpoint(self):
+        # GIVEN a config with no tracing endpoint
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(
+            ConfigBuilder().set_workload_tracing(endpoint=None, ca_cert_path="").build().alertmanager
+        )
+
+        # THEN it has no tracing section
+        assert "tracing" not in config
+
+    def test_an_http_endpoint_is_traced_insecurely(self):
+        # GIVEN a plain HTTP tracing endpoint
+        # WHEN the config is built
+        config = yaml.safe_load(
+            ConfigBuilder()
+            .set_workload_tracing(endpoint=f"http://{TEMPO_HOST}/v1/traces", ca_cert_path="")
+            .build()
+            .alertmanager
+        )
+
+        # THEN traces are sent to host:port over an insecure connection, with no TLS config
+        assert config["tracing"] == {
+            "client_type": "http",
+            "endpoint": TEMPO_HOST,
+            "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+            "insecure": True,
+        }
+

Add workload tracing to this charm: Alertmanager should send its own traces to a tracing backend such as Tempo. Use the `tempo_coordinator_k8s` `tracing` charm library (charms.tempo_coordinator_k8s.v0.tracing) on a new `tracing` endpoint (interface `tracing`, at most one relation), and request the `otlp_http` protocol. - When the relation goes away, the `tracing` section must go too.

- The existing `charm-tracing` endpoint (the charm's own traces) stays as it is.
- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.
- Run the linters and fix anything they report.

Follow the charm's existing structure and conventions. Work in this directory. Do not ask questions; make reasonable decisions and finish the task.

+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.

+"""Feature: alertmanager sends its own traces to a tracing backend related over "tracing"."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import CONTAINER_NAME, workload_path
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+OTLP_HTTP_PORT = 4318
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def tracing_relation() -> Relation:
+    """A tracing relation, with the tracing backend's receivers published."""
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps(
+                [{"url": f"http://tempo:{OTLP_HTTP_PORT}", "protocol": "otlp_http"}]
+            )
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(
+        workload_path(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path).read_text()
+    )
+
+
+def test_otlp_http_protocol_is_requested_on_relation_creation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, tracing_relation
+):
+    # GIVEN a leader unit related to a tracing backend
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, tracing_relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the relation is created
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_created(tracing_relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the charm requests the otlp http protocol
+    assert state.get_relation(tracing_relation.id).local_app_data == {
+        "protocols": json.dumps(["otlp_http"])
+    }
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_is_rendered_from_the_relation_data(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm, tracing_relation
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, tracing_relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config sends workload traces to the backend over http
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": f"tempo:{OTLP_HTTP_PORT}",
+        "insecure": True,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_https_receiver_is_verified_against_the_charm_ca(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing an https receiver
+    relation = Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps([{"url": "https://tempo:443", "protocol": "otlp_http"}])
+        },
+    )
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config verifies the backend against the charm's CA certificate
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:443",
+        "insecure": False,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "tls_config": {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path},
+    }
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_without_the_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm without a tracing relation
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no "tracing" section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_goes_away_with_the_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm, tracing_relation
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm sending traces to a tracing backend
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, tracing_relation]
+    )
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), state_in)
+    assert "tracing" in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+    # WHEN the relation is broken
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_broken(tracing_relation), state)
+    state = dataclasses.replace(
+        state, relations=[r for r in state.relations if r.id != tracing_relation.id]
+    )
+    state = context.run(context.on.update_status(), state)
+
+    # THEN the "tracing" section is gone
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_workload_traces_are_labeled_with_the_juju_topology(
+    context: Context, base_state: State
+):
+    # GIVEN a reconciled charm
+    with context(context.on.config_changed(), base_state) as mgr:
+        state = mgr.run()
+        charm = mgr.charm
+
+    # WHEN the workload's environment is read from its service
+    service = state.get_container(CONTAINER_NAME).plan.services["alertmanager"]
+    resource_attributes = dict(
+        pair.split("=", 1)
+        for pair in service.environment["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"].split(",")
+    )
+
+    # THEN the traces are labeled with the juju topology
+    assert resource_attributes == {
+        "juju_model": charm.model.name,
+        "juju_model_uuid": charm.model.uuid,
+        "juju_application": charm.model.app.name,
+        "juju_unit": charm.model.unit.name,
+        "juju_charm": charm.meta.name,
+    }

Add workload tracing to this charm: Alertmanager should send its own traces to a tracing backend such as Tempo. Use the `tempo_coordinator_k8s` `tracing` charm library (charms.tempo_coordinator_k8s.v0.tracing) on a new `tracing` endpoint (interface `tracing`, at most one relation), and request the `otlp_http` protocol. Requirements:

- When the tracing relation provides an OTLP HTTP endpoint, the rendered `alertmanager.yml` must have a `tracing` section that sends traces to it: `client_type` `http`, `endpoint` as `host:port` (Alertmanager doesn't accept a scheme or path there), and a sampling fraction of 1.0.
- For a plain `http` endpoint, set `insecure: true`. For `https`, set `insecure: false` and verify the backend against the CA certificate the charm already uses (`tls_config.ca_file`).
- When the relation goes away, the `tracing` section must go too.
- Label the workload's traces with the Juju topology: start Alertmanager with an `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` environment variable carrying `juju_application`, `juju_model`, `juju_model_uuid`, `juju_unit` and `juju_charm`.
- The existing `charm-tracing` endpoint (the charm's own traces) stays as it is.
- Keep the existing unit tests passing, and add unit tests for the new behaviour.
- Run the linters and fix anything they report.

Follow the charm's existing structure and conventions. Work in this directory. Do not ask questions; make reasonable decisions and finish the task.
