+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: alertmanager sends its own traces to a tracing backend related over "tracing".
+
+The charm's own traces (the ones the charm code produces) are sent over the separate
+"charm-tracing" relation, which is unaffected by this feature.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import CONTAINER_NAME, SERVICE_NAME, workload_path
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+from alertmanager import WorkloadManager
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: str) -> Relation:
+    """A `tracing` relation whose remote app publishes this OTLP HTTP endpoint."""
+    return Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps(
+                [{"protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"}, "url": url}]
+            )
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    return yaml.safe_load(
+        workload_path(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path).read_text()
+    )
+
+
+def test_charm_requests_the_otlp_http_protocol(context: Context, base_state: State):
+    # GIVEN a leader unit related to a tracing backend
+    relation = Relation("tracing", remote_app_name="tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN it requests the otlp_http protocol over the tracing relation
+    assert state.get_relation(relation.id).local_app_data == {"receivers": '["otlp_http"]'}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("leader", [True, False])
+def test_config_sends_workload_traces_to_a_plain_http_endpoint(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm, leader: bool
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing a plain-http OTLP endpoint
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(
+        base_state, leader=leader, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation]
+    )
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config sends the workload's traces there, in the clear
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:4318",
+        "insecure": True,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_config_sends_workload_traces_to_an_https_endpoint(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing an https OTLP endpoint
+    # (with a path, which alertmanager does not accept)
+    relation = tracing_relation("https://tempo:4318/otlp/v1/traces")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config sends the workload's traces there, verifying the
+    # backend against the CA certificate the charm already uses
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": "tempo:4318",
+        "insecure": False,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+        "tls_config": {"ca_file": alertmanager_charm._ca_cert_path},
+    }
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_without_a_tracing_relation(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm that is not related to any tracing backend
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.config_changed(), base_state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_while_the_tracing_backend_is_not_ready(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend that has not published its receivers yet
+    relation = Relation("tracing", remote_app_name="tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_when_the_backend_lacks_the_requested_protocol(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend that does not run the requested otlp_http receiver
+    relation = Relation(
+        "tracing",
+        remote_app_name="tempo",
+        remote_app_data={
+            "receivers": json.dumps(
+                [{"protocol": {"name": "zipkin", "type": "http"}, "url": "http://tempo:9411"}]
+            )
+        },
+    )
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_for_an_endpoint_without_a_port(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    """Alertmanager would exit on a config it cannot parse, so none is rendered then."""
+    # GIVEN a tracing backend publishing an endpoint that is not a host:port
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_tracing_section_is_removed_when_the_relation_breaks(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN a charm whose config sends workload traces to a tracing backend
+    relation = tracing_relation("http://tempo:4318")
+    state_in = dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+    assert "tracing" in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+    # WHEN the relation goes away
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_broken(state.get_relation(relation.id)), state)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section anymore
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+def test_config_follows_the_tracing_endpoint(
+    context: Context, base_state: State, alertmanager_charm
+):

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright 2026 Canonical Ltd.
+# See LICENSE file for licensing details.
+
+"""Feature: alertmanager sends its own (workload) traces to a tracing backend."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import json
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+from helpers import workload_file
+from ops.testing import Context, Relation, State
+
+CHARM_NAME = "alertmanager-k8s"
+
+
+def tracing_relation(url: str = "http://tempo:4318/v1/traces") -> Relation:
+    """A `tracing` relation over which a backend exposes an `otlp_http` receiver.
+
+    Args:
+        url: the url at which the receiver is reachable.
+    """
+    remote_app_data = {
+        "receivers": json.dumps(
+            [
+                {
+                    "protocol": {"name": "otlp_http", "type": "http"},
+                    "url": url,
+                }
+            ]
+        )
+    }
+    return Relation("tracing", remote_app_data=remote_app_data)
+
+
+def rendered_config(context: Context, state: State, alertmanager_charm) -> dict:
+    """The alertmanager.yml the charm rendered into the workload container."""
+    return yaml.safe_load(workload_file(context, state, alertmanager_charm._config_path))
+
+
+def state_with_tracing_relation(base_state: State, relation: Relation) -> State:
+    return dataclasses.replace(base_state, relations=[*base_state.relations, relation])
+
+
+def test_charm_requests_the_otlp_http_protocol(context, base_state):
+    # GIVEN the charm is related to a tracing backend over "tracing"
+    relation = Relation("tracing")
+    state_in = state_with_tracing_relation(base_state, relation)
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_joined(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN it requests an otlp_http receiver
+    local_app_data = state.get_relation(relation.id).local_app_data
+    assert local_app_data == {"receivers": json.dumps(["otlp_http"])}
+
+
+def test_no_tracing_section_until_a_receiver_is_available(context, base_state, alertmanager_charm):
+    # GIVEN the charm is related to a tracing backend which hasn't published its receivers yet
+    relation = Relation("tracing")
+    state_in = state_with_tracing_relation(base_state, relation)
+
+    # WHEN the charm reconciles
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config has no tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "url, endpoint",
+    [
+        pytest.param("http://tempo:4318", "tempo:4318", id="no-path"),
+        pytest.param("http://tempo:4318/v1/traces", "tempo:4318", id="with-path"),
+        pytest.param("http://tempo", "tempo:80", id="no-port"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_tracing_section_sends_workload_traces_to_the_related_backend(
+    context, base_state, alertmanager_charm, url, endpoint
+):
+    # GIVEN the tracing relation exposes an otlp http receiver
+    relation = tracing_relation(url)
+    state_in = state_with_tracing_relation(base_state, relation)
+
+    # WHEN the relation changes
+    state = context.run(context.on.relation_changed(relation), state_in)
+
+    # THEN the rendered config sends the workload's traces to the receiver,
+    # without a scheme or a path (which alertmanager doesn't accept there)
+    config = rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+    assert config["tracing"] == {
+        "client_type": "http",
+        "endpoint": endpoint,
+        "insecure": True,
+        "sampling_fraction": 1.0,
+    }
+
+

+    context, base_state, alertmanager_charm
+):
+    # GIVEN the tracing relation exposes an https receiver

+
+    # WHEN the relation changes

+    # THEN the rendered config no longer has a tracing section
+    assert "tracing" not in rendered_config(context, state, alertmanager_charm)
+

+
